_comment: Asset names -> which asset the launcher installs. Read by test_check_releases.py AND by the launcher's CatalogCheckerParityTests, so the catalog check and the launcher cannot disagree about what a release holds. pick: index of the single payload or null; parts: indices of a split payload in order; unusable: whether a split set is broken (asked only when parts is empty).

cases.name: patch zip uploaded first is not the payload
a lone patch-named zip with no descriptor is the payload
the user-data seed is never the payload
split payload in part order whatever the listing
